title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The final temperature of the sun must be correctly calculated and stated.

title: Correct Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the Stefan-Boltzmann law J = sigma T^4 appropriately.

title: Distance Ratio
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the ratio of distances (r_SE/r_S) in the calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Calculation Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student should show clear steps in their calculations leading to the final answer.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors, such as the square of the distance ratio.
